profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer at Gritter Francona.
profile.summary:
As a Senior Software Engineer at Gritter Francona since April 2022, I specialize in API development, database optimization, and scalable microservices architecture using Spring Boot. My role focuses on delivering high-volume VBA Compensation and Pension data through Benefit Gateway Services, as well as building and supporting AWS-based applications with EC2, S3, and RDS for reliable deployments.  

With over 4 years of experience in this role, I have actively contributed to creating and maintaining RESTful APIs and optimizing backend processes with efficient SQL and PL/SQL queries. Collaborating with QA and business teams, I ensure seamless system integration and operational efficiency. My passion lies in designing robust solutions that empower enterprise systems and improve data exchange capabilities.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Lead development of Benefit Gateway Services (BGS), delivering high-volume VBA Compensation and Pension data across enterprise systems
•	Designed and implemented scalable Spring Boot-based micro services for claims processing and system integration
•	Developed and maintained RESTful APIs using Spring Boot, enabling efficient, secure data exchange
•	Built and supported AWS-based applications, leveraging EC2, S3, and RDS for scalable and reliable deployments
•	Optimized backend processing with efficient SQL and PL/SQL queries, improving performance of high-volume transactions
•	Implemented complex business logic using Java Rules, improving maintainability and processing efficiency
•	Collaborated with QA and business stakeholders to validate requirements and ensure high-quality releases
•	Leveraged AI tools such as ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot to accelerate development, code generation, and debugging, improving overall productivity
•	 Integrated AI-assisted approaches for log analysis and issue troubleshooting, reducing time to resolve production defects
•	Utilized Splunk and OpenSearch for log aggregation, monitoring, and troubleshooting production issues
•	 Resolved critical production issues, minimizing downtime and improving system reliability

positions.title: Senior Java Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Architected and developed enterprise services using Spring Boot and micro services architecture

· Designed scalable systems for claims data integration and payment processing

· Developed REST and SOAP APIs with strong focus on performance and reliability

· Utilized SQL and database design principles for efficient data processing and integration

· Supported cloud-ready architecture and contributed to AWS-based deployment strategies

· Led production support, troubleshooting, and system optimization efforts

positions.title: Senior  Java/ODM Developer
positions.description: Migrated VA health benefits rules from ILOG to IBM ODM. Designed and implemented Business Object Model (BOM) and Execution Object Model (XOM). Developed and deployed ODM RuleApps. Built JUnit frameworks and test cases for rule validation. Designed mediation framework to integrate ODM with legacy systems.

positions.title: Principal System Architect
positions.description:
•	Architected and developed enterprise services using Spring Boot and micro services architecture
•	Designed scalable systems for claims data integration and payment processing
•	Developed REST and SOAP APIs with strong focus on performance and reliability
•	Utilized SQL and database design principles for efficient data processing and integration
•	Supported cloud-ready architecture and contributed to AWS-based deployment strategies
•	Led production support, troubleshooting, and system optimization efforts

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description: Developed and maintained VA health benefits eligibility and enrollment systems. Built applications using Spring and Hibernate for Oracle databases. Developed web services and implemented business rules using ILOG. Created UI components using JSP, Servlets, HTML, CSS, JavaScript. Led development of rules-based processing systems (RBPS). Generated PDF documents using Adobe LiveCycle Designer. Ensured Section 508 compliance. Supported multiple BGS modules and production environments.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
· Developed dynamic web applications using Java Servlets, JSP, and HTML

· Implemented MVC architecture for better separation of concerns

· Created stored procedures and Unix shell scripts

· Contributed to backend integration and application performance improvements

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Developed dynamic web applications using Java Servlets, JSP, and Velocity. Integrated front-end interfaces with backend systems using CORBA. Created stored procedures and Unix shell scripts.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Developed backend APIs and JavaBeans components. Implemented LDAP-based security integrations. Supported deployment and system integration activities.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: Designed system specifications and application architecture. Developed database integration using Java, JDBC, and SQL. Built XML-based formatting engine for policy data processing. Created use cases, test cases, and conducted unit/regression testing.
